DOOMBOUNCE

A browser game inspired by the DemocraTICon final. An experiment in raycasting, custom bosses, and AI-generated animation and voices.

01 / MISSION BRIEFINGBRIEF.TXT

Could we build a game in the style of classic DOOM that runs in a browser?

What we made

DOOM Bounce explores that question with a custom raycasting engine, bosses inspired by the competition, and AI-generated cutscenes and voiceovers.

It combines programming, game design, and creative asset production in one playable experiment.

Next step

Continue learning from the game’s design, performance, and production process.

  • JavaScript
  • Canvas
  • Raycasting
  • AI animation
  • AI voices

NEW RULES.

Four opponents from a campaign inspired by the DemocraTICon final. Choose an opponent and find out what awaits.

Boss encounter / wave 14

cmd

Reversed controls, a glitching screen and teleportation. Keep your aim steady when cmd takes over.
